title: Mac supervisor roundtrip: auto-started mac-local worker claims, executes, completes and pushes (no browser)
detail: Proves Founder task -> Mac supervisor detects -> mac-local auto-start -> heartbeat -> claim -> execute -> done -> push -> Founder sees result, with zero human input. Run the two test commands, record versions (node -v; claude --version) and whether PHASE2_OPERATOR is set, then done.
acceptance: result contains: bash tests/test_ops.sh PASS, node tests/test_periods.mjs PASS, node/claude versions, started_by=mac_supervisor (env PHASE2_OPERATOR=mac-local); mac-local heartbeat updated by the worker; pushed to main
